    result = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    current_friends.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

    if friend['email'] not in recipient_emails:
        result = apis.venmo.remove_friend(user_email=friend['email'], access_token=access_token)
        print(f"Removed {friend['email']}: {result}")
